{
  "slug": "ai-input",
  "name": "ai-input",
  "title": "AI Input",
  "description": "A polished AI chat composer: an auto-growing textarea, a leading model/attach control row, an empty-disabled send button that swaps to a brief pending spinner on submit, a soft focus glow, and empty-state suggestion chips that fill the field on click (Enter sends, Shift+Enter newlines). Under prefers-reduced-motion the glow pulse, spinner rotation, and chip/icon transitions resolve to instant, legible static states.",
  "category": "block",
  "family": "component",
  "dependencies": [
    "motion"
  ],
  "registryDependencies": [],
  "inspiredBy": {
    "name": "Skiper UI — AI Input (pattern); Vercel AI SDK chat genre",
    "url": "https://skiper-ui.com"
  },
  "install": "npx shadcn@latest add https://parable-three.vercel.app/r/ai-input.json",
  "registryUrl": "https://parable-three.vercel.app/r/ai-input.json",
  "props": [
    {
      "name": "placeholder",
      "type": "string",
      "required": false,
      "default": "\"Ask anything…\"",
      "description": "Placeholder shown while the composer is empty."
    },
    {
      "name": "suggestions",
      "type": "string[]",
      "required": false,
      "default": "[]",
      "description": "Optional prompt chips shown above the input while it is empty; clicking one fills the field."
    },
    {
      "name": "onSubmit",
      "type": "(text: string) => void | Promise<void>",
      "required": false,
      "default": null,
      "description": "Called with the trimmed text on submit. If it returns a promise, the spinner holds until it settles."
    },
    {
      "name": "model",
      "type": "string",
      "required": false,
      "default": "\"Auto\"",
      "description": "Label shown on the leading model pill (decorative in this demo composer)."
    },
    {
      "name": "className",
      "type": "string",
      "required": false,
      "default": null,
      "description": "Extra classes on the outer `<form>`."
    }
  ]
}
